source.name: The Works of Augustus Toplady, B.A., late Vicar of Broad Hembury, Devon
source.author: Augustus Toplady
source.note: One-volume edition; public domain (Toplady died 1778). Its "Course of Family Prayer" (pp. 771–782) was first printed from his manuscripts as A Course of Prayer, for Each Day in the Week (1790), https://archive.org/details/bim_eighteenth-century_a-course-of-prayer-for-_toplady-augustus_1790
